# function: mediapackagev2_channel_policy

Builds the ARN for `mediapackagev2` `ChannelPolicy`:

```
arn:${Partition}:mediapackagev2:${Region}:${Account}:channelGroup/${ChannelGroupName}/channel/${ChannelName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:mediapackagev2:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:channelGroup/channel-group-name/channel/channel-name
output "mediapackagev2_channel_policy" {
  value = provider::arn::mediapackagev2_channel_policy("channel-group-name", "channel-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mediapackagev2_channel_policy(channel_group_name string, channel_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `channel_group_name` (String) Value for `${ChannelGroupName}` in the ARN template.
1. `channel_name` (String) Value for `${ChannelName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
